youtube.title: Why Airplane Windows Have A Tiny Hole 🤔 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
That tiny hole in airplane windows is on purpose. ✈️

It sits in the middle pane, so the outer pane carries the cabin pressure, the middle one is the backup, and the window doesn't fog.

It's called a breather hole. It lets the air between the panes match the cabin pressure, so only the strong outer pane takes the load at 35,000 feet, and it lets moisture escape so you can still see the view.
